tour.name: Mexico Highlights 10-Day Private Tour: Mexico City, Teotihuacan, Oaxaca, Chichén Itzá & Tulum
tour.subtitle: Ten days across Mexico with private guides: the Aztec and colonial capital, Teotihuacan and Frida Kahlo, the food and Zapotec heritage of Oaxaca, then the Yucatán with Mérida, Chichén Itzá, cenotes, Tulum and the Caribbean.
tour.metaDescription: 10-day private Mexico tour: Mexico City, Teotihuacan, Coyoacán and Xochimilco, Oaxaca and Monte Albán, Mérida, Chichén Itzá, cenotes and Tulum. Domestic flights, private guides and 9 nights included.
highlights: The Zócalo, the Templo Mayor and the Anthropology Museum
Frida Kahlo’s Blue House and Xochimilco
Monte Albán, mezcal and Hierve el Agua in Oaxaca
Chichén Itzá and a cenote swim
tour.overview:
Mexico is a country of great civilisations, colonial cities, extraordinary food and Caribbean beaches. This private tour links its highlights with two domestic flights: Mexico City and Teotihuacan in the highlands, Oaxaca in the south, and the Maya world of the Yucatán peninsula, ending on the Caribbean coast.

You have private guides and vehicles in each region and nine nights in well-located hotels, with time to enjoy the food and the beaches.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 10 days, 9 nights
• Start: Mexico City airport or your hotel
• End: Cancún airport
• Type: private tour with licensed guides, private vehicles and domestic flights; 9 nights with breakfast
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, hotels, flights and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy to moderate

WHAT YOU SEE
• Mexico City.
• Teotihuacan.
• Coyoacán and Xochimilco.
• Oaxaca and its valleys.
• Mérida, Chichén Itzá and Valladolid.
• Tulum and the Riviera Maya.

WHY THIS WORKS
Flying between regions saves long road journeys, and private guides bring each culture to life.

WHO IT SUITS
First-time visitors, couples, families and food lovers.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
Add Palenque, San Cristóbal or more beach days.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Mexico City is at 2,240 metres. Domestic flights include a checked bag. Use biodegradable sun cream in cenotes.

private: 2 domestic flights (Mexico City–Oaxaca, Oaxaca–Mérida) with a checked bag
9 nights with breakfast: 3 in Mexico City, 2 in Oaxaca, 2 in Mérida or Valladolid, 2 in Tulum
Licensed private guides and private vehicles for all visits
Entrances, boat and tastings in the programme
Lunches on the guided excursion days

days.name: Mexico City: the Zócalo and the Anthropology Museum
days.description:
What to expect: Aztec and colonial Mexico.

The Zócalo, the cathedral, the Templo Mayor, Diego Rivera's murals, Bellas Artes, tacos al pastor and the National Museum of Anthropology.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Zócalo.
14:30 – Museum.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The museum is closed on Mondays.

INCLUDED: vehicle, guide, entrances, tasting.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch.

Overnight: hotel in Mexico City.
Meals: breakfast.

days.name: Teotihuacan, Coyoacán and Xochimilco

NOT INCLUDED: dinner.

Overnight: hotel in Mexico City.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Are the domestic flights included?
faq.answer: Yes, two flights with a checked bag.

faq.question: Can we add beach days?
faq.answer: Yes, in Tulum or Playa del Carmen.

faq.question: What kind of hotels are used?
faq.answer: Comfortable 4-star or boutique hotels; upgrades are available.

faq.question: Is Mexico safe for visitors?
faq.answer: The places on this itinerary are popular and welcoming; your guides advise you throughout.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. We book family rooms and adapt the pace.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. Tell us your needs and we will adapt.

faq.question: Can we add Palenque?
faq.answer: Yes, with an extra flight or a road journey.

faq.question: Are meals included?
faq.answer: Breakfast daily and lunch on the main excursion days.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Layers for the highlands, light clothes and swimwear for the coast.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in Mexico: 10 to 15 percent for guides and drivers is usual if you were happy with the service, but it is always your choice.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour starts. Flights are non-refundable once issued. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
